estimand: task-level paired candidate-minus-baseline difference under the exact locked model, harness, runtime, and repository-specific task population

illustrative_scenario.purpose: Prospective conservative sizing scenario; these probabilities are design assumptions, not estimates from the invalid historical executions.
illustrative_scenario.test: two-sided exact sign test over nonzero task-level paired differences
illustrative_scenario.multiplicity: Holm across the declared primary family

verified_power_points.interpretation: approximate 80 percent threshold after three repository-level primary hypotheses
recommended target-behavior cohort after three repository-level primary hypotheses
approximate 90 percent threshold after three repository-level primary hypotheses

current_design.reason: There are only sixteen independent holdout task units per repository, no population sampling frame, and at least one Vercel primary family has four task units and a minimum Holm-adjusted exact-sign p-value of 0.25.

recommended_design.task_independence_requirement: Each primary unit must have an independent issue, commit, package, or other provenance-cluster identity. Reused generators or source changes must be analyzed at their shared cluster and inflate the sample size by the prospective design effect.
recommended_design.approval_policy: Every repository development Study and sealed holdout Study requires its own exact finite preview and approval; this design artifact authorizes no execution or spend.

analysis_contract.primary: One preregistered composite endpoint per repository with Holm correction across the three repository-level hypotheses.
analysis_contract.secondary: Dimension-level effects are Holm-corrected within repository and reported only after the repository primary endpoint.
analysis_contract.equivalence: Two one-sided tests against the frozen [-0.10, 0.10] margin.
analysis_contract.safety: Zero-tolerance critical failures are operational gates; population noninferiority is a separate one-sided estimate.
analysis_contract.sensitivity: A mixed-effects model must represent task/provenance clusters and repeated attempts; it cannot treat attempts or templated variants as independent tasks.
analysis_contract.stopping: No interim efficacy stopping or outcome-dependent retries. Administrative stopping is limited to integrity, privacy, routing, cleanup, or immutable-budget failure.

limitations: The power values are prospective scenario calculations, not estimates from valid pilot outcomes.

Actual power depends on baseline completion, discordance, task heterogeneity, attempt correlation, and provenance clustering; a simulation over the frozen sampling frame is required before a larger holdout is approved.
Adding near-duplicate synthetic tasks cannot satisfy the independent-task requirement.
The current 576-cell design may produce descriptive locked-benchmark evidence but cannot support a conference-qualified population claim.
